description: This file defines a lightweight implementation of the TextWatcher interface to simplify handling text change events in Android UI components. It wraps the onTextChanged callback with a lambda, allowing screens to only implement the behavior they need.

classes.name: SimpleTextWatcher
classes.description: A wrapper class for the TextWatcher interface that provides a simplified way to handle text changes with a lambda callback.

methods.name: beforeTextChanged
methods.description: No-operation override, called before the text is changed.

methods.name: afterTextChanged
methods.description: No-operation override, called after the text has changed.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Invokes the provided lambda with the current text when the text is being changed.
